mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM client_registry WHERE status = 1 AND last_heartbeat >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 5 MINUTE)
SELECT * FROM client_registry WHERE app_code = #{appCode} AND status = 1 AND last_heartbeat >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 5 MINUTE)
mapper.update: UPDATE client_registry SET last_heartbeat = NOW(), status = 1, app_code = #{appCode}, app_version = #{appVersion}, config_version = #{configVersion}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE client_id = #{clientId}
UPDATE client_registry SET status = 0, updated_at = NOW() WHERE last_heartbeat < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 5 MINUTE)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM client_registry WHERE last_heartbeat < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR)
